# Step 1: Read data file with output statistics

The tibble that was created with `Prepare_mitigation_measure_data.R` is read in.
This tibble contains output from all mitigation measures for the high and low
scenarios, for 10000 monte carlo runs for three years (2022, 2030 and 2050). 

```{R Load libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{R Load functions}
files <- list.files("R/CaseStudies/Report_152_2025/Mitigation_measures/functions", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)
for (f in files) source(f)
```

```{R Define paths}
source("R/CaseStudies/Report_152_2025/paths.R")
data_folder <- paste0(output_path, "/")
figure_path <- paste0(figures_path, "/Mitigation_measures_high_res")
```

# Analysis of results
If the above script was run and the outsaved to an rds file, best to read in that one, using e.g. ("Output/20251017_ClothingDataAll.rds").

Define plot theme
```{R}

# Create a theme for the plots
plot_theme = theme(
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
  plot.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  axis.line = element_line(color = 'black'),
  plot.margin = margin(2, 4, 2, 2, "cm")
  #panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey",size=0.25)
)

plot_theme2 = theme(
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
  plot.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  axis.line = element_line(color = 'black'),
  plot.margin = margin(2, 4, 2, 2, "cm")
)

dpi <- 1000
Analysistag <- "20251017"
```

# Report figures
Below the figures for RIVM report 152-2025 are made and saved.

In the figures below, the effect of all mitigation measures is compared to the baseline. 
All emissions are summed over polymers, micro/macro and environmental sinks. 

```{R Read in aggregated clothing data}
ClothingStatsOverview <- readRDS("R/CaseStudies/Report_152_2025/Mitigation_measures/AggrData/ClothingStatsOverview.rds") |>
  mutate(data_source = case_when(
    data_source == "Production method finishes low" ~ "Production method low",
    data_source == "Production method finishes high" ~ "Production method high",
    TRUE ~ data_source
))
```

```{R Figure 9}
Figure9 <- 
  PlotMeasureOverviewPercent(
    MeasuresData = CalcClothOverviewEffect(
      ClothingStatsOverview=ClothingStatsOverview
    ),
    ReduceExclude = 100,
    MeasOrdering = 'max',
    PlotStats = c("Mean_mass_t", "zero"),
    OutputData = FALSE,
    Scenario = "high",
    ErrorMargin = 0.5
  )


Figure9Data <- 
PlotMeasureOverviewPercent(
  MeasuresData = CalcClothOverviewEffect(ClothingStatsOverview),
  ReduceExclude = 100,
  MeasOrdering = 'max',
  PlotStats = c("Mean_mass_t", "zero"),
  OutputData = TRUE,
  Scenario = "high",
  ErrorMargin = 1
)

print(Figure9)

ggsave(
  paste0(Analysistag, "Figure9_ClothingEmissionReductionPercentHigh.png"),
  plot = Figure9,
  path = figure_path,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = dpi
)
```

```{R Figure 10}
Figure10DataIn <- CalcClothOverviewEffect(ClothingStatsOverview) |> 
  filter(Measure %in% c("Production method",
                        "Replace",
                        "External filter",
                        "Lifetime",
                        "Delicate washing cycle",
                        "Fringes",
                        "Prewashing"))

Figure10 <-
PlotMeasureOverview(
  MeasuresData = Figure10DataIn,
  ReduceExclude = 0,
  MeasOrdering = 'min',
  PlotStats = c("p25_t","p75_t"),
  OutputData = FALSE,
  Scenario = "high"
)

Figure10data <- 
PlotMeasureOverview(
  MeasuresData = Figure10DataIn,
  ReduceExclude = -15,
  MeasOrdering = 'min',
  PlotStats = c("p25_t","p75_t"),
  OutputData = TRUE,
  Scenario = "high"
)

Figure10data |> ungroup() |> 
  group_by(scenario,statistics) |> 
  summarise(Reduced = sum(`Reduced MassFlow (t)`))

ggsave(
  paste0(Analysistag, "Figure10_ClothingEmissionReductionPercent.png"),
  plot = Figure10,
  path = figure_path,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = dpi
)


print(Figure10)
```
